rules: GML is an open geographic data format used across Europe and HM Land Registry uses it to comply with the EU INSPIRE Directive
HM Land Registry uses GML to provide a standard data structure usable by GIS and CAD systems
using HMLR GML in another tool can require both format conversion and selection of an appropriate map projection
QGIS can open HMLR GML and convert it to other geographic data formats
HMLR technical guidance lists ESRI Shapefile MapInfo MIF or TAB AutoCAD DXF GeoJSON and KML as example conversion targets
National Polygon Poly_ID is a unique spatial-object identifier managed through dataset lifecycle rules
National Polygon Shape is mandatory geometry and must represent a single area
National Polygon Title_No is mandatory and uniquely identifies a registered title to land
National Polygon INSERT records the date the polygon was initially created on the index map
National Polygon UPDATE records the date all or part of the title was last updated
National Polygon Vers_No records the version of Poly_ID
National Polygon Rec_Status uses Added Changed and Deleted lifecycle states
Title Descriptor specifies that every registered title has a title number estate and class of title
a pending registration application can have a title number while estate and class-of-title information are not yet present
Title Descriptor Registered Status uses Pending for an application being processed and blank for registered while Change Indicator records New Changed or Deleted
Planning Data entity API q can search by postcode or Unique Property Reference Number
Planning Data documents UPRN search as more precise than coordinate search for registered properties
multiple dataset parameters can be supplied and the coordinate query returns entities from any selected dataset whose geometry covers the point
entity API supports typology as an array search parameter
entity API supports dataset as an array search parameter
entity API supports organisation_entity as an array search parameter
entity API supports entity as an array search parameter
entity API supports curie as an array search parameter
entity API supports prefix as an array search parameter
entity API supports reference as an array search parameter
entity API period parameter can request current or all entries
entity API supports start_date_year filtering
entity API supports start_date_month filtering
entity API supports start_date_day filtering
recent authoritative title-boundary JSON separates the numeric entity identifier from the title-boundary reference and exposes organisation-curie government-organisation:D69
Environment Agency exposes the survey-index catalogue through an OGC API Features 1.0 landing service
the survey-index OGC service publishes a machine-processable API description conforming to OpenAPI 3
the OGC service publishes a collections endpoint listing available feature collections
the LIDAR_Composite_1m_DTM_2022_extents collection is available in the official OGC service
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection storage CRS is EPSG:27700 British National Grid
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes filename as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes tilename as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes polygon_id as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes resolution as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes year as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes od_dtm_fn as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes sd_flown as a queryable field
the LIDAR Composite 1m DTM extents collection exposes ed_flown as a queryable field
official OGC collection outputs support KML GML CSV JSON OGC Features JSON and GeoJSON representations
the National_LIDAR_Programme_Index_Catalogue is exposed as a separate official feature collection
National LIDAR Programme index records expose DTM filename and 5km tilename fields for survey provenance
National LIDAR Programme index records expose flown dates survey identifiers season resolution year and delivery metadata
the 1m DTM dataset has no public access constraints and is licensed under the Open Government Licence
OS Terrain 50 grid heights are represented as a raster with values calculated at pixel centres
OS Terrain 50 grid construction means adjacent tiles do not overlap and do not share common height values along tile edges
mean high and low water lines in the grid are assigned constant height values based on an average for each tile derived from local tide tables
OS warns that tidal modelling can create a small discrete height step between adjacent grid tiles
in permanent tidal water the mean-low-water height is extended to the tile edge and foreshore heights are interpolated between mean high and low water
OS Terrain 50 contours are represented as polyline and spot-height features
Terrain 50 spot heights are selected by an algorithm using the highest source point within each enclosed contour
OS notes that interpolated Terrain 50 spot heights cannot be guaranteed to be true summits or highest real-world points
currently all OS Terrain 50 spot-height features are attributed as generic
a full national supply of OS Terrain 50 grid tiles is documented as 157 MB compressed
OS Terrain 50 tiled downloads use ZIP compression and the supplied archives are not encrypted
OS Terrain 50 open-height content includes contours spot heights breaklines coastline lakes ridges and formlines
